- Climax: "The day's scans were already settling onto a drive" → "The week's scans had already settled onto a drive."
- Fixed a follow-on contradiction: Ray's-pending-tray option no longer says the batch would "never be scanned at all" (these originals were already scanned); it now reads "back in the tidy hands that had re-filed it once already."
